==Quotes==
===Gossip===
My name is Karfang, I am leader here.

My people should cause you no harm, lest you insult or bother them too much. There are many things to discuss, and many things to do for us to secure our place in this world.

The Blackrock Clan find themselves manipulated by greater forces. The Old Horde is a shell of what it once was, and I will not allow my people to follow them into madness.
